title: La música
goal: Ask a neighbour to turn it down at one in the morning
culture: Music at volume is normal and complaining about it is not, so the entire thing is done as a favour asked rather than a right asserted. Politeness gets it turned down. A complaint gets it turned up, and then you live next door to that for a year.

beats.es: (La música se oye desde la calle. Es la una de la mañana.)
beats.good: You open by apologising for existing. That is not weakness here — it is the move that decides how the next thirty seconds go.

beats.en: Would you do me a favour?
beats.good: Ask for a favour rather than assert a right. The music is not illegal and you are not owed silence — you are asking a neighbour for something.
Say the fact and stop talking. Add what you want after it and you are complaining; leave it there and she will say it for you.

beats.es: Ay, sí pues. Ya la bajo, no se preocupe.
beats.good: Se lo agradezco is a size up from gracias, and it is the right size for somebody who did what you asked at one in the morning.
